eng_codes.traineddata.gz is a warehouse-code variant of eng.traineddata.gz
from the same tessdata_fast upstream revision recorded in upstream-commit.txt.

It removes only TESSDATA_LSTM_SYSTEM_DAWG (component 19, the English word
dictionary). The LSTM network, character set, recoder, punctuation and number
dictionaries and version are retained byte-for-byte. Used only for ASCII
location codes and SKU digits; full Chinese/English OCR uses the original data.

The upstream Apache License 2.0 in LICENSE continues to apply.
The conversion can be reproduced with tools/make-eng-codes.cjs in this repo.
